matches.description: Watch Excelsior vs FC Volendam highlights and goals from Eredivisie on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 10, 2026. Excelsior and FC Volendam faced off on May 10, 2026 , in an Eredivisie clash that delivered drama from the opening whistle. In front of a crowd of 4,600, both sides looked to make a statement in a match characterized by contrasting styles and tactical shifts. Early Fireworks and a Costly Mistake The match ignited almost immediately as FC Volendam stunned the home supporters in the 2nd minute. Benjamin Pauwels found space outside the box and, after receiving a pass from Juninho Bacuna , unleashed a precise right-footed strike that flew past the goalkeeper into the net. This early goal forced Excelsior to chase the game, and they responded with waves of pressure. Derensili Sanches Fernandes was central to their efforts, delivering several corners as the hosts searched for an equalizer. The persistence of the home side finally paid off in the 38th minute, albeit through a stroke of misfortune for the visitors. During a dangerous Excelsior attack, Gibson Yah inadvertently directed the ball into his own net while trying to clear the danger. The own goal brought the scores level just before the interval, erasing Volendam's lead and setting the stage for a tense second half. Dominance Without a Decisive Blow The second half saw Excelsior exert significant control over the match, maintaining a dominant 67% of ball possession. Despite their superior ball retention, clear-cut chances were hard to come by as FC Volendam sat deep and defended resolutely. Tactical changes were made by both managers, with Brandley Kuwas and Szymon Wlodarczyk coming on for the hosts, while Henk Veerman was introduced for the visitors. The physical nature of the contest intensified, leading to yellow cards for Nick Verschuren , Adam Carlen , and Alex Plat . In the closing stages, Brandley Kuwas had a chance to snatch a winner with a direct free kick in the 76th minute, but his effort sailed wide of the post. Despite a late flurry of activity in the opponent's half and three minutes of added time, neither side could find the decisive breakthrough. The match ended in a draw, leaving both teams with a point after a battle that saw Excelsior's possession met with Volendam's disciplined defensive display.

matches.description: Watch Sparta Rotterdam vs Excelsior highlights and goals from Eredivisie on ReFooty: Football Highlights Hub. Match played on May 17, 2026. On 2026-05-17 , the Eredivisie delivered a high-octane encounter at the Sparta Stadion as Sparta Rotterdam hosted Excelsior . In front of an engaged crowd of 10,599 fans, the match provided a masterclass in emotional swings, featuring early errors, a second-half goal fest, and a climax that left one side celebrating and the other in total disbelief. Early Setback and Tactical Struggle The match began under a cloud of misfortune for the hosts. Just 14 minutes into the contest, Giannino Vianello inadvertently directed the ball into his own net, gifting Excelsior an early lead. Sparta Rotterdam struggled to find their rhythm following the own goal, and their frustrations were further compounded when Vito van Crooij saw yellow late in the first half. Despite holding a slight edge in possession, the home side entered the break trailing, unable to convert their pressure into clear-cut opportunities. A Flurry of Second-Half Action The game exploded into life following the restart. Excelsior doubled their advantage in the 50th minute through Arthur Zagre , who clinical finish looked to have put the visitors in total control. However, Sparta Rotterdam responded almost immediately; Ayoni Santos pulled one back in the 53rd minute to ignite the home support. The momentum swung back toward the visitors shortly after, as Noah Naujoks rose highest to head home a Gyan de Regt cross in the 62nd minute, restoring the two-goal cushion. Late Drama and VAR Intervention As the clock ticked into stoppage time, the atmosphere reached a fever pitch. Milan Zonneveld gave the hosts a lifeline in the 91st minute, finishing coolly after being set up by Tobias Lauritsen . Just moments later, the stadium erupted as Zonneveld appeared to have completed a miraculous comeback with a second goal. However, the celebrations were cut short by a lengthy VAR review. The referee eventually overturned the goal due to a foul in the buildup, leaving Sparta Rotterdam heartbroken. Despite a late effort from Patrick van Aanholt , Excelsior held firm to secure a dramatic victory.
